## v1.18.0

### Highlights

#### Many new model integrations

This release includes support for three models for UI automation:

- **Qwen4-Max** (`qwen4-max`), with model family `qwen4`. [Qwen configuration guide](https://midscenejs.com/model-api-setup#qwen)
- **Tencent Hunyuan 4** (`hy4`), with model family `tencent-hy`. [Tencent Hunyuan configuration guide](https://midscenejs.com/model-api-setup#tencent-hy)
- **StepFun Step 3.7 Flash** (`step-3.7-flash`), with model family `step`. [StepFun configuration guide](https://midscenejs.com/model-api-setup#stepfun)
